name: Authentication & Logons
description: Successful logons (4624), failed logons (4625), explicit credentials (4648), special privileges (4672) & logoffs (4634, 4647)

name: Brute Force & Password Spraying
description: Failed logons (4625), account lockouts (4740), Kerberos pre-auth failures (4771), and NTLM validation failures (4776)
sql: EventId IN (4625, 4740, 4771) OR (EventId = 4776 AND COALESCE(PayloadData1, '') NOT ILIKE '%0x0%')

name: Kerberoasting, AS-REP & Pass-the-Hash
description: Kerberos TGT/TGS ticket requests (4768, 4769), RC4 downgrade (0x17), and Pass-the-Hash NTLM Type 3/9 logons (4624)
sql: EventId IN (4768, 4769, 4770, 4771) OR (EventId = 4624 AND (COALESCE(PayloadData1, '') ILIKE '%NtLmSsp%' OR COALESCE(PayloadData1, '') ILIKE '%LogonType%9%'))

name: RDP & Remote Desktop Sessions
description: RDP auth (1149), LocalSessionManager session logon/reconnect/disconnect (21-25), RDP client (1024, 1102), and Type 10 logons (4624, 4778, 4779)
sql: EventId IN (1149, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 39, 40, 4778, 4779, 1024) OR Channel ILIKE '%TerminalServices%' OR (EventId = 4624 AND COALESCE(PayloadData1, '') ILIKE '%10%')

name: SMB, Admin Shares & WinRM Lateral Movement
description: Network share access (5140, 5145), outbound explicit creds (4648), SMBClient connectivity (30803), and WinRM WSMan shells (6, 91, 168)
sql: EventId IN (5140, 5145, 5142, 30803) OR Channel ILIKE '%WinRM%' OR Channel ILIKE '%SMB%'

name: PowerShell & Script Host Execution
description: ScriptBlock logging (4104), module/pipeline execution (4103), engine start/stop (400, 403), and command execution (800)

name: Process Creation & Sysmon Telemetry
description: Security process creation (4688), process exit (4689), and Sysmon process/network/DLL/injection events (1, 3, 7, 8, 10, 11, 22)

name: Services & Scheduled Task Persistence
description: New service installed (7045, 4697), service state/type change (7036, 7040), and Scheduled Task creation/update (4698-4702, 106, 140, 200)

name: WMI Persistence & Remote WMI Activity
description: WMI EventFilter, EventConsumer, and FilterToConsumerBinding creation (19, 20, 21, 5861) and WMI execution fail/activity (5857, 5858, 5860)

name: BITS Jobs & Background Payload Transfers
description: Background Intelligent Transfer Service job creation (3), transfer completion (4), and remote URL downloads (59, 60, 61)
sql: Channel ILIKE '%Bits-Client%' OR (EventId IN (3, 4, 59, 60, 61, 16403) AND Provider ILIKE '%Bits%')

name: Account Management & Privilege Escalation
description: User created/enabled/deleted (4720, 4722, 4726), password reset (4724), and admin group modifications (4728, 4732, 4756, 4738)

name: Windows Defender & Endpoint Detections
description: Malware detected (1006, 1116), remediation action (1007, 1117), failure (1118, 1119), real-time protection disabled (5001), exclusions added (5007)

name: Log Clearing, Clock Tampering & Anti-Forensics
description: Security audit log cleared (1102), System log cleared (104), audit policy modified (4719), and system time changed (4616)

name: Shadow Copy (VSS) & Ransomware Indicators
description: Volume Shadow Copy service stop/errors (7036, 8222) and VSS backup deletion events
sql: EventId IN (8222, 8193, 8194, 524) OR COALESCE(Provider, '') ILIKE '%VSS%' OR COALESCE(PayloadData1, '') ILIKE '%Shadow Copy%'

name: Windows Firewall Rules & Port Openings
description: Firewall rule added/modified/deleted (2004, 2005, 2006, 2033, 4946, 4947, 4948) and firewall profile disabled (2003)

name: USB & External Storage Mounts
description: Partition table/volume mount events (1006), PnP device installation (400, 410), and DriverFrameworks USB insertion (2003-2102)
sql: EventId IN (1006, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2010, 2100, 2102, 6416) OR Channel ILIKE '%Partition%' OR Channel ILIKE '%DriverFrameworks%' OR Channel ILIKE '%Kernel-PnP%'

name: Application Crashes, WER & MSI Installations
description: Application crashes/faults (1000), Windows Error Reporting (1001), and MsiInstaller package installations (1033, 1040, 11707, 11724)

name: System Boot, Shutdown & Unexpected Reboots
description: Kernel boot (12), clean shutdown (13), dirty shutdown (41), user-initiated restart/shutdown (1074), and EventLog service start/stop (6005, 6006, 6008)
